label: Whole actual roster withheld with replacement allowed
definition: WithholdsActualRosterAt F w g: at one accessible world v where g exists, g gives being (GivesTo) to none of the beings it gives being to at w; it may give being to others at v. WithholdsEachAt F w g: each being g gives at w is withheld at some accessible world where g exists (different recipients may use different worlds).
note: Stipulative giving-level counterpart of NoActualContingentConcreteIn (the actual-population omission scope of optimal-creation-choice.md §56). It neither requires nor excludes that no contingent concretum exists at v. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §61.
